entries.06a0df087067b7b5: The reportable segments are two: the housing building materials and equipment business and the power generation business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥64,945 million for the housing building materials and equipment business and ¥1,054 million for the power generation business. The breakdown of revenue in the housing building materials and equipment business is interior trim ¥35,076 million, other building materials ¥19,074 million, flooring ¥6,804 million, and housing equipment ¥3,990 million. Revenue by region is ¥47,560 million for Japan, ¥11,441 million for New Zealand, ¥3,253 million for the United States, and ¥3,744 million for other regions. The major customers are Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. (¥8,001 million, 12.1% of consolidated revenue) and SMB Kenzai Co., Ltd. (¥7,268 million, 11.0%), both of which are sales destinations in the housing building materials and equipment business.

entries.545aa62df8545b23: The company's management philosophy is "As a first-class manufacturer in the industry, to pursue its core business, devote itself to its core business, and contribute to the development of society by providing first-class products to customers." In its management strategy and other initiatives, it states that it will practice: securing stable quality and volume of raw materials through its afforestation business in New Zealand; further improving wood processing technology; creating "markets it can win × ways to win" in new growth markets such as Asia and the domestic renovation, non-residential and commercial environment markets; developing domestic and overseas manufacturing networks, efficient operations and cost reduction; and responding to domestic and overseas needs by using certified wood. It also states that, to improve corporate value and strengthen its financial position, it will work on improving profitability and maintaining and raising its equity ratio.
